subject: Price Fortress: multi-year commitment approval request
messages:
From: J. Morales <jmorales@lumenix.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 3yr price lock + uplift cap for multi-year commitment

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — Lumenix is excited about the performance numbers. Procurement asked me to reach out with a commercial ask so we can align with finance: they want a 3-year committed agreement with a hard price lock on the listed SKU and an annual uplift cap of 8% for renewals. They also want a "renewal protection" clause that prevents unilateral price increases beyond the cap during the term and on automatic renewals (unless there is a material change in scope).

Attached is a short procurement worksheet with our expected volume profile and preferred billing cadence. Can you confirm if Redwood can grant this and what approvals would be required?

Thanks,
J. Morales
Sourcing Manager, Lumenix
Attachments: Lumenix_MLP_commitment_v1.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: J. Morales <jmorales@lumenix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3yr price lock + uplift cap for multi-year commitment

Hi J.,

Appreciate the clear ask and the worksheet — I reviewed it with our AE team. We're keen to get Lumenix on a 3-year commitment, but the terms you requested are outside standard commercial guardrails. I looped in Marissa (Deal Desk) and Karthik (Sales leadership) to surface for exec review.

Proposed starting point for approval request:
- Term: 36 months
- Price lock on current SKU list for term duration
- Annual uplift cap: 8% (customer asks)
- Renewal protection: automatic renewals subject to same uplift cap; any >8% increase requires mutual written agreement
- Minimum annual committed spend: see worksheet attached (will mirror their expected profile)

Marissa / Karthik — can you review and advise: 1) risk to unit economics, 2) whether we can approve 8% uplift cap without CFO signoff, and 3) any conditions (escrow, termination right, reporting cadence) you want on the approval?

Next steps: if approved, I will send an updated term sheet and route for signatures (DocuSign).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
Attachments: redwood-proposal-2027-04-19.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 3yr price lock + uplift cap for multi-year commitment

Thanks Mina — a few clarifying Qs before I escalate to pricing approval:

1) Do we have the projected annualized usage and expected token mix for years 1–3? (workbook shows ranges; need committed minimums to size risk)
2) Is Lumenix asking for any data residency/KMS exceptions as part of the private deployment? That materially changes cost.
3) Are there any requested SLAs beyond standard?

Initial thoughts: 8% uplift cap is within a feasible band but depends on modeled unit costs. If they truly lock pricing on the exact SKU without quantization/variant flexibility, that increases risk as model/hardware mix evolves. I recommend:
- Conditionally approve price lock + 8% uplift cap with the following controls:
  - Minimum annual committed ARR >= $1.2M;
  - Right to substitute to functionally equivalent model variants with 30 days notice if underlying compute economics change (with 8% cap on list price);
  - Standard reporting cadence (quarterly usage reports) and 60-day cure period for underperformance/overuse.

I'll prepare a redlined term-sheet (price-fortress-term-sheet.docx) and queue for Karthik's sign-off. If the ARR delta vs. standard pricing is > $250k/year, we will need finance/CFO glide path signoff.

Marissa
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: J. Morales <jmorales@lumenix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-29T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: 3yr Price Lock + 8% Uplift Cap (next steps)

Hi J.,

Good news — Redwood can approve Lumenix's requested structure. Executive approval granted with the controls outlined below (see Karthik's email for full details):
- 36-month commitment, minimum $1.2M ARR (or equivalent prepayment)
- Annual uplift cap: 8% on listed SKUs
- Renewal protection while auto-renewal remains subject to the cap; substitutions allowed for equivalent model variants with prior notice
- Quarterly reporting, audit rights, and early termination fee as described

Attached is the updated term sheet (price-fortress-term-sheet.docx). Marissa will start the finance review for the ARR impact and route for signatures via DocuSign once we confirm any prepaid structure.

Please let me know a preferred time this week for a 30-minute call to review the term sheet and finalize timing for signatures. If we don't receive a signed commitment by 2027-05-06, this approval will expire and we'll need to re-escalate.

Thanks for moving quickly — excited to partner with Lumenix on this.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
